judgments.rationale: The unchanged draft reading in C0000 fully and accurately states the statutory reporting requirement. It includes the specified regulated actors (manufacturers, distributors, and retailers), the jurisdictional exception for motor vehicle equipment, the four informational triggers under paragraphs (1) through (4), the mandatory modal force ('shall'), the timing requirement ('immediately'), and the exception where the entity has actual knowledge that the Commission is already adequately informed. Referenced provisions outside the text (such as subsection (a)(2), section 2058, and title 49) are properly preserved without inventing unavailable material, and the separate restriction on criminal prosecution in F007 constitutes an independent rule addressed in C0001 rather than a governing condition of this reporting duty.
